helpful: Statpack interim section with per-Term substantive counts made the strictly-prior pool arithmetic direct.
fedcourts query --include-applications with counsel rows allowed a local pro se vs counseled tally of application dispositions.
gaps: fedcourts query has no filter for application kind, fee/pro se status, or respondent type; the tally needed a 400-row pull and local filtering.
No provisioned application text for interim cells; the ask and posture had to be inferred from the caption.
RECAP coverage of Ninth Circuit mandamus petitions is thin, so the lower-court matter could not be identified.
An interim statpack cut by applicant class (pro se / counseled / government) would give a far better anchor than the pooled 20%.
notes: Four MCP calls and two corpus queries, well inside the advisory budget.
